original_card.question: Can one selected pricing or assembly claim be checked by a genuinely independent exact implementation?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Recompute one small part of the ledger or one certified enclosure using an independent implementation.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Independent exact enclosure of the complex moment root of the pending pivot-566+554 T74 supplier (profile {1:1560432, 2:336336, 3:278724, 4:84912, 5:54612, 8:5328, 48:22748}, m=73, W=66304): native and conservative brackets at the 1e-70 endpoints of CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1672 (head b8ab040d) and the 1e-10000 endpoints of CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1928 (head 07e4e423), their nesting, the provider/idle profile composition, and the position of each PR's headline kappa below the native endpoint.
scope_change_reason: The selected CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1094 ledger, both moment endpoints, invoice and outer slacks already have independent checks (frontier1094-emitted-ledger-seed78, selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic, pr1407-complex-moment-audit-seed39, CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1735). The card's enclosure method is applied instead to the supplier root behind the highest open claims (CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1800 through CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1928), where kappa tends to this root at the free epsilon -> 1 point and no independent enclosure was found.
bottleneck_link: Every pending claim from CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1800 to CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1928 takes this certified native endpoint as b; an error in it would propagate to all of them. This package checks that number by a code-disjoint method. It does not check the outer reduction, the construction or admission, and it does not change kappa.
stop_rule: Stop when both models' brackets pass at both grids with all semantic controls rejected, or report the first bracket that fails or stays undecided at four times the default precision.
evidence: RESULT.json: four brackets pass (1e-70 at 360 bits; 1e-10000 at 33347 bits, no refinement needed); the 1e-70 endpoints equal the 1e-70 floors of the 1e-10000 endpoints for both models; both PR heads' provider profiles (249 gauge44 + 417 extra calls) plus 22748 idle rank-48 children sum to the global profile, rank mass 4816512, deficit 23680; CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1928's headline kappa is 2.003e-10010 below its native endpoint, CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds#1672's is 2.817e-6 below. 10 semantic controls rejected. Optional crosscheck_decimal.py (decimal at 10060 digits) agrees on all 7 log enclosures and 4 signs.
